heroSub: In the project implemented at Whirlpool's home appliances factory in Manisa, a camera-based reader was positioned at the sorting point to ensure controlled transit of products.
contextP1: In the project implemented at Whirlpool's home appliances factory in Manisa, a camera-based reader was positioned at the sorting point to ensure controlled transit of products.
contextP2: The project was carried out in order to automatically detect and block faulty or unauthorized products.
problemLede: At the sorting point, products had to be recognized correctly and those that were not allowed to pass (blacklisted) had to be sorted.

problemList.text: Human-caused errors and quality risks associated with running sorting operations manually.
Lack of an automatic control structure to instantly screen out faulty or unauthorized products from the line.

solutionLede: Through the camera-based reader placed at the sorting point, both the image and the serial number info of each passing product were sent to the system. The captured product image was matched with the product's serial number and recorded. If the product was blacklisted, its passage was automatically blocked. The application was made operational by integrating it into the customer's existing systems.

steps.title: Camera-Based Reading
steps.text: Serial numbers of products passing through the sorting point are scanned via camera.

steps.title: Image Matching
steps.text: The captured product image is instantly matched with the serial number and recorded.

steps.title: Blacklist Query
steps.text: Product info is passed through the blacklist filter to check its compliance.

steps.title: Automatic Blocking
steps.text: When blacklisted products are detected, their passage is physically stopped via PLC.

techTitle: Image processing and field control system

techGrid.title: Camera-Based Reader
techGrid.text: Camera that reads serial numbers of products passing through the sorting point with high accuracy.

techGrid.title: PLC Field Flow Control
techGrid.text: PLC infrastructure managing sorting gates, sensors, and transit locks.

techGrid.title: OnSuite Trace Platform
techGrid.text: Central software recording image-data matches and managing blacklist decisions.

techGrid.title: Blacklist Verification
techGrid.text: Control logic preventing the passage of faulty products and sending stop commands to the PLC.

integrationDesc: The application works integrated with the customer's existing systems; product images and control data matched with serial numbers are shared with these systems, allowing transit decisions to be managed centrally.

integrationList.text: Sorting decisions and product matching data are synchronized with the customer's central database.

resultsTitle: Fully automated and controlled product flow

resultsGrid.title: Blacklist Blocking
resultsGrid.text: The advancement of unauthorized or faulty products past the sorting point is automatically and reliably prevented.

resultsGrid.title: Image & Data Pairing
resultsGrid.text: Each product's image is automatically paired with its serial number, enabling retrospective visual verification.

resultsGrid.title: Reduced Manual Workload
resultsGrid.text: Automating sorting controls eliminated human errors and accelerated the operation.
